title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Elementor…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Elementor Website Builder versions up to 4.3.5. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers with limited privileges and requiring user interaction to potentially execute malicious scripts. The flaw impacts confidentiality, integrity, and availability to a limited extent.
